# Socket.IO browser client

Version: 4.8.4, minified UMD browser distribution. Compatible with the
Flask-SocketIO 5.x / python-socketio 5.x protocol family.

Downloaded from the official distribution:
https://cdn.socket.io/4.8.4/socket.io.min.js

Upstream release and license:
https://github.com/socketio/socket.io/releases/tag/socket.io-client%404.8.4
https://github.com/socketio/socket.io/blob/socket.io-client%404.8.4/packages/socket.io-client/LICENSE

MIT license: see LICENSE. The distribution's copyright/license header is retained.
This file is served locally; these source URLs are never required at runtime.
